dimensions.assessment: Affects individuals seeking gynecological health care, state health agencies, and researchers studying uterine health.
dimensions.evidence: award grants to States to increase early detection of and intervention for uterine fibroids

dimensions.assessment: Supports screenings, patient navigation services, public awareness campaigns, and research initiatives.
dimensions.evidence: Screening procedures, including advanced gynecological imaging, including payment for such procedures

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes grant programs and research funding, though exact dollar figures are not specified in the text.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may award grants to States for carrying out programs

dimensions.assessment: Directs federal research strategies and creates new grant authorities for state-level health programs.
dimensions.evidence: formulate evidence-based or evidence-informed strategies to increase early detection

dimensions.assessment: Establishes ongoing reporting requirements to Congress every two years following initial grant awards.
dimensions.evidence: Not later 2 years after the initial award of grants... and every 2 years thereafter
